name: Day log Part E smoke test

definition.title: Day log Part E smoke test ({{run}})
definition.body_md: Phil's live check of Day log Part E — linked users (0133), shipped 2026-09-22. The boundary was proven on the local stack from a second account (lib/access/daylogLinked.test.ts, 9/9) and the single-account half on production; this ticket is the human half: link a real teammate, then look through their eyes. It needs a second Mycelium account in a team with you — the test mailbox from the cutover will do. Tick as you go; anything that fails stays unticked with a comment naming the step id.

steps_definition.title: Day log Part E smoke test

values.label: The People entry that IS that account (approved onto at least one closed day)

intro.verdict_html: Three phases, about 15 minutes with two browsers (or one normal, one private window). Phase 1 links. Phase 2 is what the other account sees — and does not see. Phase 3 hides and unlinks.
prerequisites: A second Mycelium account ({{viewer}}) in a team with you — Settings → Teams → invite, accept in the other browser
{{person}} has been approved onto at least one closed day (the Part B or C check did this), with a photo on that scene if you want to test sharing one
Two browsers signed in as each account

steps.title: As you: People → {{person}} → the Days block header has LINK TO A TEAMMATE. The dropdown offers {{viewer}} with the team name — and nobody who is not in a team with you
Pick {{viewer}} → LINK. The header now reads "Linked to {{viewer}}" with UNLINK

phases.title: Through their eyes
phases.lede_html: Everything in this phase is in the other browser, as {{viewer}}.

steps.title: As {{viewer}}: Journal → the date of a day {{person}} was on. A card "With <your name>" lists the scene(s) they were in: title, place, the names in the scene, the scene line. Photos only if you marked one shared
The card shows NO entry text, NO facts, NO scores, NO transcript, and no scene {{person}} was not in. Their own Journal list does not show your day as theirs

fields.label: Anything visible that should not be

steps.title: As {{viewer}}: People → {{person}} does not exist for them (your People are yours); The Boys → Ask about your day finds nothing of yours

As you: on that day page, a scene card's chip row ends with SHARED WITH LINKED — click it → HIDDEN FROM LINKED. As {{viewer}}, reload: that scene is gone from the card (the card itself goes if it was the only one)
As you: a photo on a shared scene shows "private" in its corner — click it → "shared". As {{viewer}}, reload: the photo appears on the card and opens
As you: People → {{person}} → UNLINK. As {{viewer}}, reload: no "With …" card anywhere. Re-link if you want to keep it

fields.label: Would you actually link someone? What is missing?
fields.placeholder: yes / needs a note on why they can see it
